actions.name: demonic restoration
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

actions.name: magic resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two [[/item .mmPincer00000000]] attacks and uses [[/item .mmPummel00000000]] or [[/item .mmSpellcasting00]].

actions.name: pincer
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition (escape DC [[lookup @skills.ath.passive]]) from one of two pincers.

actions.name: pummel
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=aae828c0Hue0XOMP]], one creature Grappled by the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: spellcasting
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]): At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDarkness00]{Darkness}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detect Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDispelMagi]{Dispel Magic} 1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplConfusion0]{Confusion}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFly0000000]{Fly}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplPowerWordS]{Power Word Stun}
